title: Introduce field-level completeness and evidence states
objective: Completeness measures facts, applicability and test attempts separately.
outcome: Completeness measures facts, applicability and test attempts separately.

commits.subject: Define field observation state
commits.instructions: Add versioned value/evidence/applicability/attempt fields using existing contracts. Separate unsupported, missing, not-applicable, conflict, not-attempted and restricted; retain historical values on failure. Represent documented credential requirements, access costs and usage limits separately from observations, including unknown/conflicting values and evidence timestamps. Credential fields contain names or placeholders only; undocumented cost is unknown, never free by default.
commits.verification: Validate fixtures where unknown is not false, an identifier has no physical unit, and an expired observation retains its historical success. A documented key requirement and an unattempted payload check remain distinct; an unknown price or quota cannot become zero or unlimited.

commits.subject: Project coverage from source facts
commits.instructions: Build per-record/per-source counts for supported fields, attempted checks and essential readiness. Derive counts from the ledger rather than title tags or populated UI strings.
commits.verification: Reproduce the audit baseline and partition each denominator exactly; four isolated records remain accounted for.

commits.subject: Publish a machine-readable completeness view
commits.instructions: Expose the versioned coverage artifact to offline consumers with field reasons and last-attempt timestamps. Keep aggregate scores supplemental to the full vector. Expose a compact access-summary projection with credential, cost and usage-limit evidence plus the latest successful check and latest attempt, each scoped to its endpoint/resource and operation. Preserve endpoint-specific browser/CORS observations for developer recipes; never infer browser usability from server-side success.
commits.verification: Validate whole-catalog arithmetic and a record with mixed successful, restricted and failed checks. Metadata/document reachability cannot populate a successful payload-access badge; stale success remains historical and access-summary fields retain documented-versus-observed provenance.
